scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/api build
scripts.tst: bun run --cwd packages/shared test --dots && bun run --cwd apps/api test --dots && bun run --cwd apps/web test --dots
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p .
scripts.api:generate: bun run --cwd apps/api contract && bun run --cwd packages/contract generate
scripts.pr: bun tst && bun lint && bun typecheck && bun run build
